text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how was it?! The birthday 
present from Maya and Mave-chin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It was such a wonderful pen! I tried 
using it in class, and it wrote like a 
dream!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, right~?! I was super picky about 
how it looked when I picked it out☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You were fretting over it forever, Mayano! 
Worrying if it was too cute and made you 
look like a kid☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! It is kind of a cute design, for 
sure. However—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It was such a gorgeous cherry blossom 
pink. And above all, its cute design 
reminded me of you two."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It was cute, energetic... and so very 
'like the two of you.' That made me 
happiest of all♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...! Actually, there's a much bigger 
secret to that...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When you press this switch, the lid pops 
off and a tiny rocket shoots out! Like, 
*whoooosh*â

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Eh!? ...Fufu! It really is a present 
that's 'so like the two of you'...!
